publicationId.description: The prefixed ID of the publication object

segmentId.description: The prefixed ID of the segment object

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. The limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.

page.description:
Pagination returns the results in pages. Each page contains the number of results specified by the `limit` (default: 10).
If not specified, results 1-10 from page 1 will be returned.

limit.description: The limit placed on the results. If no limit was specified in the request,this defaults to 10.

page.description: The page number the results are from. If no page was specified in the request, this defaults to page 1.

total_results.description: The total number of results from all pages.
